tools.name: sire_question_lookup
tools.description: Search SeaReady's original-wording SIRE 2.0 preparation question bank (12 chapters). Returns question titles; Free-readable checks also include what good looks like, the evidence an inspector expects and common negative grounds. Not OCIMF text — for preparation only.

tools.name: psc_checklist
tools.description: Port State Control preparation items for one deficiency area (an area id such as "cert", "crew", "fire", "lsa", "nav", "mach", "pol1", "ism", "isps" — or words from the area title such as "certificates" or "fire safety"). tools.name: inspection_deadlines
tools.description: Known upcoming dates in vetting and PSC regimes (e.g. concentrated inspection campaigns, RightShip rule changes) with days remaining, plus when SeaReady last verified each module.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "sire_question_lookup" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
